summary: The @gyomu/ai package provides a modular, resilient framework for orchestrating AI interactions within a TypeScript application. It abstracts model management, request routing with automated fallbacks, and structured tool execution to ensure consistent and testable AI integration.
responsibilities: Define a unified interface for AI model registries and model retrieval.
Orchestrate intelligent request routing with support for multi-model fallback strategies.
Standardize the lifecycle, validation, and authorization of AI-executable tools.
Provide a robust, dependency-injected execution environment using Effect services.
Manage structured error reporting and diagnostics across AI service operations.

capabilities.name: Model Registry Management
capabilities.description: Centralized registration and retrieval of language and embedding models, allowing for consistent model configuration and injection.

capabilities.name: Resilient Request Routing
capabilities.description: Advanced routing logic that enables defining chains of model nodes, allowing systems to automatically fail over to alternative configurations during execution.

capabilities.name: AI Tooling Framework
capabilities.description: Standardized architecture for defining tools, including schema-based input validation, execution context management, and security via approval policies.

capabilities.name: Provider Abstraction
capabilities.description: Pluggable provider architecture that wraps lower-level SDKs to maintain consistent behavior across different model backends and vendors.

designDecisions: Utilizes the Effect library for dependency injection, service management, and functional error handling.
Implements a 'Registry' pattern to decouple model configuration from service consumption.
Adopts a 'Routing Node' architecture to support complex fallback logic without coupling execution handlers to specific model providers.
Encapsulates tool execution within a formal Context object to ensure all required state and identity information is explicitly passed.
usageGuidance: Register model configurations via the AiModelRegistry to ensure they are available for dependency injection.
Define complex request flows using the routing service to leverage built-in fallback capabilities.
Implement tools using the AiTool interface, ensuring that input schemas and approval policies are correctly configured.
Always use the provided error context types to wrap failures, facilitating better debugging and observability in production.
